47-Day Certificates Are Closing In

Public TLS certificates are already capped at 200 days and drop to 47 by March 2029, and PQC deadlines are on the calendar. Waiting is no longer the safe option.

The Vendor Landscape Keeps Shifting

Platforms get acquired, rebranded and quietly re-architected constantly. What was the clear right fit two years ago may no longer be the right fit today.

Most Problems Surface After Purchase

Integration gaps, scaling limits and hidden costs are hard to spot without hands-on testing. By the time they surface, switching is expensive.

What Is a Needs Assessment and Solution Selection?

Needs Assessment and Solution Selection is a vendor-agnostic advisory engagement that helps you choose the right cybersecurity platform before you buy, not after. It documents your requirements, scans the market for competing platforms that fit, and tests the shortlist hands-on in the Accutive Security Innovation Lab. The result is a recommendation grounded in your environment, not a vendor's pitch.

Cryptography and Machine Identity

PKI, certificate lifecycle management, code signing, and secrets management.

Data Protection

HSMs, key management, and encryption platforms.

Identity Security

IAM, CIAM, and privileged access platforms.

How Does a Solution Selection Work?

Assessing your current environment and identifying gaps is covered by our Cybersecurity Assessments and PKI Assessments. Once you know where the gaps are, Solution Selection starts at Discovery.

01Discovery

We document your requirements, current environment, and constraints, not a generic feature checklist. You get a documented requirements baseline that every later step measures against.

Accutive Security Innovation Lab

Real Environments, Not Sales Demos

Most platform evaluations stall at the demo stage: polished, scripted, and disconnected from your environment. The Accutive Security Innovation Lab exists to skip that stage entirely.

We maintain fully functional environments for leading platforms across cryptography, identity, and data protection, already configured and ready to test. When your shortlist is set, we run proof-of-concepts against your actual requirements, not a vendor's canned script.

Product demos are run by the same engineers who implement these platforms in production, not a sales team reading from slides. Hosted lab sessions, integration testing, and team training all happen in the same environment, so the platform you evaluate is the one your team trains on.
